_doc: Cameras in plan cm (x east, y south, z up), house type 4 ground floor, floor 0.
exterior: ground floor at garden level: through the glass a landscaped garden in golden-hour light - lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, a warm limestone terrace right outside, soft green hills far away under a warm golden sky with a few soft clouds. Never sea, never city, never night.
time_of_day: golden hour, about 18:30 in late spring - low warm sun from the south-west streams in through the glass, long soft honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls, warm glowing air; bright, warm and inviting - never night, never dark

fittings._head: Light fittings: ONLY these, exactly as modelled in IMAGE 1:
fittings.pendant_black_linear: the slim black bar hanging on cables over the island is a linear black pendant
fittings.pendant_bronze: the angled bronze bars on cables over the dining table are sculptural linear bronze pendants
fittings.lamp_black: black cylinders on the nightstands are small black table lamps
fittings.walnut_facets: the pure-white lines on the faceted walnut bed wall and its canopy are its warm LED seams
fittings.marble_white_panel: the two pure-white vertical lines framing the white marble wall are slim LED lines
fittings.cabinet_greige: the white line under the upper cabinets is a warm under-cabinet LED
fittings.bronze_mesh: the island's bronze mesh front glows with a soft warm backlight
fittings.walnut_fluted: the two pure-white vertical lines at the edges of the fluted walnut wall are slim warm LED lines
fittings.walnut_battens: the short white lines under the stair nosings are warm step lights
fittings.mirror_backlit: the mirror glows softly from behind
fittings.plaster_white: a pure-white line along the edge of a dropped ceiling band is a warm cove light
fittings._none: Light fittings: none in this view - golden-hour daylight only.
fittings._tail: Add NO other light of any kind: no spotlights, no downlights, no track lights, no recessed ceiling lights, no extra LED strips, no wall lights, no chandeliers, no glowing outlines along edges. The thin GREY guide lines are not lights.
fittings._decor: Decor: only the modelled objects - olive trees in stone pots (green sphere on a trunk), dried pampas (beige stems), slim olive branches in small vases, line-art sketches and large abstract paintings and a triptych of tall abstract paintings in frames, books, ceramic bowls, lemons, rugs, cushions, sheer linen curtains; add no new objects.
fittings.ceiling_dark: the pure-white line running all round the edge of the dark ceiling is a warm shadow-gap cove light

cameras.title: Living - frontal view of the fluted walnut wall with the triptych over the sofa
cameras.notes: Straight-on frontal view: the fluted walnut wall rises the full DOUBLE HEIGHT (5.6 m) and its top edge meets the ceiling in one perfectly horizontal line. Three tall abstract paintings (triptych) hang on the walnut wall above the sofa. The living ceiling is completely FLAT and horizontal at 5.60 m - a plain warm-white plaster plane; every wall and the glass meet it in a crisp straight 90-degree corner. Never sloped, pitched, vaulted, angled or stepped. On the left the dining under its lower 2.8 m pale-oak ceiling. Through the glass: golden-hour garden - lawn, clipped hedge, olive trees, a stone terrace outside the glass, soft hills under a warm golden sky.

cameras.title: Living - from beside the sofa to the double-height glass corner
cameras.notes: The double-height glass corner: both glass walls rise the full 5.6 m and meet the flat ceiling; the vertical corner where they meet is a straight vertical line. cameras.title: Ensuite - wide corner view
cameras.notes: This ensuite is 70 % DARK: near-black Nero Marquina marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; ONLY the shower back wall and the vanity top are the warm cream marble (the light details). Ambient, intimate lighting from the ceiling cove, the backlit mirror, under the vanity and the niche, plus a little warm daylight from the small window - moody and luxurious, not bright.
